reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-11-14' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS nov_revenue_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-14' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS dec_revenue_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-14' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-11-14' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS change_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-11-14'
   OR order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-14'
GROUP BY parent_category
alternatives:
WITH nov AS (
  -- one row per parent category with sales on 1 to 14 November
  SELECT parent_category, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-11-14'
  GROUP BY parent_category
), dec AS (
  -- one row per parent category with sales on 1 to 14 December
  SELECT parent_category, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-14'
  GROUP BY parent_category
)
SELECT COALESCE(d.parent_category, n.parent_category) AS parent_category,
  COALESCE(n.revenue_eur, 0) AS nov_revenue_eur,
  COALESCE(d.revenue_eur, 0) AS dec_revenue_eur,
  COALESCE(d.revenue_eur, 0) - COALESCE(n.revenue_eur, 0) AS change_eur
FROM dec d
FULL OUTER JOIN nov n ON n.parent_category = d.parent_category

WITH both_periods AS (
  -- one row per parent category with sales in either period
  SELECT parent_category,
    COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE order_date <= DATE '2025-11-14'), 0) AS nov_revenue_eur,
    COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-12-01'), 0) AS dec_revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-11-14'
     OR order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-14'
  GROUP BY parent_category
)
SELECT parent_category, nov_revenue_eur, dec_revenue_eur, dec_revenue_eur - nov_revenue_eur AS change_eur
FROM both_periods
